about.label: 01 — About
about.title: A frontend
about.caption: EEE graduate by training, web developer by trade. I gravitate to the seam where visual design meets the code that actually runs it.
about.blurb: Electrical & Electronics Engineering graduate turned web developer. I build accessible, performant interfaces — currently shipping React + TypeScript products at Workhall.
about.blurb2: 2.5+ years building scalable web apps with React, TypeScript, Redux, and Node. I've cut load times by 20%, boosted team efficiency by 40%, and publish open-source packages. Always open to interesting collaborations.

items.label: Calendar Simple
items.desc: Production-grade React calendar library published to npm. Features Month, Week, Day, Schedule and Custom Days views, rich event management with multi-day spanning and custom styling, full TypeScript support, ARIA accessibility, keyboard navigation, dark mode, RTL, and i18n via Luxon.

items.label: Social Media
items.desc: Full-stack social platform with JWT-based authentication, protected routes, post creation and editing, profile management, and a follow graph — delivering a seamless experience across all authenticated workflows.

items.label: Happy Chat
items.desc: Real-time 1-to-1 chat app with end-to-end encryption, Socket.io-powered messaging, typing indicators, avatars, and message persistence.

items.label: Job Search
items.desc: Job listings browser with filtering, search and saved roles.

items.label: Weather App
items.desc: City-based current & forecast weather using a public weather API.
